t_advice_summary_textbox.text: keep track of the colour of the gnome, the value changes over time and it's best to use the 1x to check the value

vb_textbox.text: Keep an eye on the colour of the gnomes throughout the game and keep track of their value. The value will change overtime but use the gnome size and colour as a reference to what the gnome's value is. A good time to test this is when the multiplier is at 1x. When it is at 5x go for the gnome with the highest value.
